questions.question: What must the user do to mark something with a star in Love Rendezvous?
questions.subject: Love Rendezvous

answer.item: In order to mark something with a star, the user must make physical contact with someone's cursed energy.

questions.question: What does anyone marked with a star experience when the technique is activated?
questions.subject: Love Rendezvous

answer.item: Anyone that has been marked will experience a sparking light above their head when the technique is activated. They can also find the name of the star they've been marked with written somewhere on their body.

questions.question: How many stars can be placed on one person's cursed energy at a time?
questions.subject: Love Rendezvous

answer.item: Only one star can be placed on one person's cursed energy at a time but the same star can be applied to multiple different people's cursed energy.

questions.question: What did Panda compare the feeling of being unable to approach the monitor room to?
questions.subject: Love Rendezvous

answer.item: He compared the feeling to experiencing Satoru Gojo's Infinity.
